Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning implementation of the learning assistance program for students needing remediation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to implementation of the learning assistanceprogram for students needing remediation; and amending RCW 28A.165.005.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.165.005 and 2013 2nd sp.s. c 18 s 201 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter is designed to: (a) Promote the use of data whendeveloping programs to assist underachieving students and reducedisruptive behaviors in the classroom; and (b) guide school districtsin providing the most effective and efficient practices whenimplementing supplemental instruction and services to assistunderachieving students and reduce disruptive behaviors in theclassroom. (2) School districts implementing a learning assistance program((shall)) may determine whether the district will focus first onaddressing the needs of students who need remediation to pass thestatewide assessments required for high school graduation in RCW28A.655.070 or the needs of students in grades kindergarten through p. 1 SB 6107four who are deficient in reading or reading readiness skills toimprove reading literacy.
